name: Gala Crowd
disable: DC 19 Intimidation check, DC 21 Diplomacy check, or DC 24 Athletics check to get guests to move out of harm's way; four total successes across all skills are required to disable the hazard
routine:
(1 action) The crowd reacts in one of the following ways, determined by a d12 die roll:
- 1–2 Hunker Down: The crowd freezes in fear. It provides lesser cover to all creatures in the great room for 1 round.
- 3–4 Run!: Determine a random direction. Each creature in the area must succeed at a DC 21 Fortitude save save or be moved 10 feet in that direction. On a critical failure, they're also knocked Prone. This is forced movement.
- 5–6 Hysteria: The crowd's dread is contagious. Each creature in the area must attempt a DC 21 Will save save or become Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure). This is an emotion, fear, and mental effect.
- 7–8 Wailing: The cries make it hard to concentrate. For 1 round, any creature in the area that attempts an action with the concentrate trait must succeed at a DC 4 Flat check or the action is disrupted. This is an auditory effect.
- 9–10 Crushing Press: Members of the crowd shove and push, trying to find a way to safety. Each creature in the area takes 2d8+5 bludgeoning damage (DC 21 basic Fortitude save save).
- 11–12 Wild Dismay: The chaos is overwhelming. Each creature in the area must attempt a DC 21 Will save save or become Confused for 1 round. This is an emotion and mental effect.

items.name: Panic at the Gala
items.text:
Trigger A creature rolls initiative

---
Effect The crowd stampedes, dealing 4d6 bludgeoning damage to anyone on the great room floor (DC 20 basic Reflex save save), then rolls initiative.

text: The panicked crowd of gala attendees reacts to the unexpected attack.
